personalInfo.name: Linden Hutchinson
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer
personalInfo.description: Software engineer with 7+ years building backend systems and AI products in Python and PHP. Currently working on voice AI, MCP servers, and integrations at a VC-backed startup.

experience.description: Engineer at a VC-backed startup building a screen-aware voice AI assistant that guides users through product onboarding and activation. Stack: FastAPI, Firebase, and Svelte.
achievements: Designed and solely built an MCP server and AI chatbot giving stakeholders and customers natural-language access to product data; has served 10,000+ queries that previously required manual work, saving stakeholders hours on reporting and data extraction.
Implemented a full OAuth 2.0 authorisation flow for the MCP server, with PKCE and JWKS-based token verification, enabling secure native integration with Claude.

Owned the architecture and delivery of Google Calendar and Microsoft 365 integrations powering a new activation channel, issuing 10,000+ invites that bring users into onboarding sessions with the voice assistant.
Reduced voice call latency, tuned assistant prompts, and built an idempotent, monotonic event ledger so each call event is recorded exactly once and in order.
Built an AI-assisted development workflow, orchestrating parallel Claude Code agents as architect and reviewer to deliver multiple workstreams concurrently.

experience.description: Full-stack engineer on a core Laravel/Kohana marketplace platform and GraphQL API, focused on backend performance, observability, and developer experience.
achievements: Cut execution time of a key SQL query by 96% through query and index optimisation.
Delivered features across the GraphQL API and React applications, owning work end-to-end from requirements through release.
Conducted a security audit of the codebase, identifying and remediating SQL injection and XSS vulnerabilities to safeguard user data.
Improved observability with New Relic, Sentry, and Grafana, enabling proactive detection of performance bottlenecks.
Introduced new testing strategies and improved the developer experience of the test suite, increasing deployment confidence.
Partnered with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

experience.description: Senior member of the software team developing high-security Python products for Australian Government clients and internal SaaS solutions.
achievements: Co-authored a report on the commercial viability of open-source LLMs; led the evaluation workstream, designing standard and novel benchmarks to compare capability across model families and sizes.
Architected an internal greenfield React application with complex multi-API integrations and high-security requirements.
Led code reviews and mentored developers on security best practices and coding standards.
Resolved critical bugs in a legacy Django application, including a hidden issue that had persisted for 6 months, saving the team 30 minutes of manual workarounds per day.
Built internal tools and APIs on a modern Python stack (FastAPI, Django Ninja, HTMX).
Built CI/CD pipelines with automated builds and Pytest suites to ensure secure, reliable deployments.

experience.description: Modernised legacy PHP environments and built custom full-stack solutions for enterprise clients.
achievements: Stabilised a legacy PHP system by diagnosing and resolving long-standing core reliability issues.
Built a bespoke Laravel application for event management, automating manual workflows.
Engineered a Vue.js data dashboard backed by a PHP REST API, with test coverage in PHPUnit and Playwright.
Optimised complex SQL queries over multi-million-row datasets to maintain application performance.

projects.title: Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: A real-time social deduction game on a modern Python backend. Built with Django Ninja for typed REST APIs and Django Channels/Redis for low-latency communication, with a decoupled Alpine.js frontend, containerised with Docker.

projects.title: AFL Data Analysis
projects.description: A data engineering and analysis platform for the Australian Football League. Automated scrapers collect match scores (1897-present), player statistics, and historical betting odds, feeding Python cleaning pipelines and Jupyter notebooks for statistical modelling.
